relations.text_en: Invested $250 million in its Bellefield unit

source.label: AES 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In November 2024, AES Clean Energy, AES Clean Energy Development, and Bellefield Equity Holdings LLC ("Bellefield") entered into several key agreements with HASI, including an investment agreement under which HASI invested $250 million in Bellefield in exchange for a preferred membership interest.
